Title: # note
Woolacombe August 1910: * Erratum: Owing to the transfer of the barometer at Woolacombe to a new position the height of the instrument above the ground has been given incorrectly in the reports since April 1908. The new height has not yet been determined accurately. It is approximately 41 feet instead of 29 feet, making the height above Mean Sea Level about 100 feet. The exact height will be published as soon as it has been determined.
